primary_demographics.gender_skew: Heavily engaged female and podcast-crossover audience drawn to investigative rigor, victim advocacy, and timeline reconstruction
primary_demographics.reading_frequency: 2 to 7 investigative nonfiction titles per month across ebooks, audiobooks, and print
preferred_formats: Digital Ebook (EPUB / Kindle / Mobile Web Reader)
Trade Paperback with Timeline & Source Notes

reading_motivations: Reconstructing complex timelines, forensic breakthroughs, and trial turning points accurately
Understanding behavioral red flags, investigative failures, and systemic blind spots
Honoring victims with dignity and factual precision rather than sensationalism
emotional_payoffs: Clarity as scattered court transcripts, witness reports, and forensic records snap into a coherent timeline
Respectful vindication when overlooked evidence finally brings accountability or closure
Actionable awareness of real-world patterns and investigative persistence

cover_design_rules: Documentary-grade archival texture, atmospheric location photography, or clean evidence-file typography legible at 120px
High-contrast editorial palette (charcoal, bone white, crimson, or muted brass) signaling factual rigor
Clear factual subtitle specifying location, year/era, or central investigative question
blurb_structure_rules: Paragraph 1 (The Tagline Hook): Factual 12-to-20-word premise anchoring the real date, place, and central mystery
Paragraph 2 (The Case & Victim Humanity): Ground the people affected and the unsettling discrepancy that defied easy answers
Paragraph 3 (The Investigation & Turning Point): Highlight the overlooked records, forensic shift, or dogged investigator who refused to close the file
Paragraph 4 (The Ultimatum Closer): Frame what the public record finally revealed—and what questions linger—with a clear series CTA

chapter_word_count_targets.mobile_scroll_pacing_note: Anchor every chapter with a clear date/location header and keep sections between 2000 and 3400 words for bingeable documentary flow.

structural_beats: Open with verified scene-setting and the fateful turning point within the first 500 words
Center the victim's life, community context, and the initial official assumptions
Expose the first documented timeline contradiction by the 25.00 percent mark
First Half (25.00 to 50.00 percent): Trace early leads, jurisdictional friction, and overlooked physical records
Midpoint Reversal (50.00 percent): A fresh witness, DNA/digital record, or FOIA release flips the investigative focus
Second Half (50.00 to 75.00 percent): Legal hurdles, stalled appeals, or mounting pressure on the primary suspect
The Counter-Play (75.00 to 88.00 percent): Reconstruct the prosecution or cold-case task force's decisive evidentiary chain
The Climax (88.00 to 95.00 percent): Trial verdict, confession, or definitive forensic identification
The Resolution or Series Cliffhanger (95.00 to 100.00 percent): Summarize verified aftermath, policy/reform impact, and source notes

mandatory_chapter_exit_hooks: The Archival Contradiction: A verified receipt, call log, or deposition line that disproves the official alibi
The Cold-Case Reopen: A new detective or journalist spotting an unexamined box in evidence storage
The Courtroom Pivot: A surprise ruling or forensic exhibit entering the record
The Unanswered Record: Closing a chapter on the exact gap investigators next had to bridge
cliffhanger_cadence.series_arc_cliffhanger_strategy: Organize thematic regional or era anthologies (e.g., Cold Case Files Vol. 1–3) where each volume stands alone completely with full source citations.

core_tropes_readers_expect.name: Timestamped Timeline Reconstruction
core_tropes_readers_expect.execution_rule: Header chapters with clear dates and locations so readers track movements, alibis, and evidence chains effortlessly.

core_tropes_readers_expect.name: Dignified Victim-First Framing
core_tropes_readers_expect.execution_rule: Humanize victims through verified family memories and lived context rather than reducing them to crime-scene statistics.

core_tropes_readers_expect.name: Documented Source Attribution
core_tropes_readers_expect.execution_rule: Distinguish strictly between verified public records, sworn testimony, and clearly labeled investigative hypotheses.

cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.name: Invented Composite Dialogue Presented as Fact
cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.prevention_rule: Never fabricate verbatim quotes or private thoughts without explicit attribution to sworn testimony, recordings, or memoirs.

cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.name: Gratuitous Gore & Sensationalism
cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.prevention_rule: Report forensic facts clinically and respectfully without lingering on exploitative violence.

cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.name: Defamatory Unverified Accusations
cliches_and_anti_patterns_to_avoid.prevention_rule: Rely strictly on public court filings, official investigative files, and documented journalism.

protagonist_models.archetype: The Persistent Cold-Case Investigator / Investigative Journalist
protagonist_models.core_drive: Giving overlooked families answers through meticulous archival and forensic verification
protagonist_models.strengths: Patience with paper trails, empathy in interviews, disciplined skepticism
protagonist_models.fatal_flaw: Emotional toll from carrying unresolved injustice across years of dead ends

antagonist_models.motivation: Concealing guilt behind social charm, jurisdictional gaps, or lost paperwork
antagonist_models.tactic: Relies on time, intimidation, and fragmented records to evade scrutiny

foil_and_ensemble_dynamics.the_family_advocate: Relative or community organizer whose persistence kept the case alive in public memory
foil_and_ensemble_dynamics.the_forensic_specialist: DNA genealogist, ballistics analyst, or digital forensics expert unlocking modern leads
foil_and_ensemble_dynamics.spin_off_seeding_rule: Cross-reference related regional casebooks and offer downloadable timeline dossiers on the author's GrabLab CMS storefront.

pov_conventions.preferred_pov: Objective Narrative Nonfiction Third-Person (journalistic documentary voice)
pov_conventions.secondary_pov_option: First-Person Investigative Memoir when authored by a case participant or journalist
pov_conventions.head_hopping_rule: Never invent unattributed internal thoughts of real people; attribute perspectives strictly to documented records.

rhythm_and_vernacular_rules: Use verbatim excerpts only where grounded in transcripts, interviews, or public records
Maintain crisp, authoritative journalistic pacing free of melodramatic speculation
Use clear transitions between archival chronology and courtroom scenes

signature_urban_textures: Auditory: Microfilm reels clicking, courtroom gavel, distant highway hum along a county road
Visual: Fluorescent basement archives, faded polaroids, annotated street maps
Olfactory and Tactile: Aged newsprint, dry courthouse oak, winter wind outside a precinct

clarity_directives: State dates, names, and verifiable actions clearly in active voice
Eliminate vague hedging clichés when citing documented evidence
Keep paragraphs focused (2 to 5 sentences) so complex timelines stay effortless to follow

series_launch_strategy.extended_universe_model: Offer a free 0.00 Case-File Dossier lead magnet, individual casebooks at 2.99 to 4.99, anthology bundle at 9.99, and trade paperback at 14.99.

direct_to_reader_and_kdp_hybrid_windowin: Direct Documentary Storefront: Host companion timelines and source appendices on GrabLab CMS alongside 4.99 digital / 14.99 print editions.
Anthology Funnel: Bundle 3 regional casebooks at 9.99 with exact ADR-025c pricing.
